title: Learning Compact 3D Representations from Feed-Forward Novel View Synthesis

layout.note: Three pale-mint rounded tiles of unequal size. The wide top-left tile holds the pipeline: input photos at the left, three module boxes in two rows, a dashed outline around the Gaussian set, and a big framed feature-field render at the right. Below it a strip titled Applications shows four labelled sample renders. A tall right tile stacks three teal-headed chart blocks, separated by thin rules, each with its own legend.

lesson: A teaser can combine one pipeline tile, a strip of application renders on a single scene and a column of mini charts in which the proposed method is the only accent colour against grey baselines, so headline numbers such as 2K Gaussians and 4.1 MB read at a glance.
